title: Oven-Toasted Turkish Bread Dolma
description: A salty, dense Turkish dish featuring toast, perfect for a hangover cure, made with fodmap-friendly ingredients in a dolma form
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the Turkish bread into 1-inch thick slices and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the olive oil over the bread slices and sprinkle with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Toast the bread in the oven for 10 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Remove the bread from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the garlic-infused oil, chopped parsley, crumbly feta cheese, and chopped scallions.
Spoon the dolma mixture onto the toasted bread slices, leaving a small border around the edges.
Serve the oven-toasted Turkish bread dolma warm, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
